title: The Gravity of New Lagos
premise: Petra Thackeray, the last xenolinguist on New Lagos, has begun dreaming in a language no human taught her — the dying signal of the colony's alien co-founders, the Vess. When she discovers a name on the manifest of a ship that officially never flew, she uncovers the Fleet's plan to abandon and erase New Lagos before its truce with the Vess expires. Racing across dead space to reach the relay that carries the truth, Petra must choose between loyalty to the Fleet family that raised her and the record of what was actually done to the colony. She reaches the relay as the truce expires, broadcasts the full archive — including her own complicity — and New Lagos survives not through rescue but through being remembered.
about_author: L. M. Amberdale is the pen name of a former shipping-manifest archivist who spent eleven years cataloguing decommissioned colony vessels before turning to fiction. They write from a coastal town where the fog arrives on schedule, like a fleet.

chapters.title: The Language of Dying Things
chapters.summary: Petra records the final audible Vess transmissions over the flooded districts of New Lagos, noting her dreams have stopped using English. Her assistant Idris warns her the Fleet survey team is due. POV: Petra. Beat: quiet dread — beauty and decay entwined.

chapters.title: Manifest of a Ship That Never Flew
chapters.summary: Auditing decommissioned records, Petra finds the corvette Halcyon Step listed as crewed by forty-one people, though it never launched; one name, 'A. Okafor,' matches no Fleet registry. POV: Petra. Beat: the first hook — an impossible document.

chapters.title: The Survey Team Arrives
chapters.summary: Fleet liaison Commander Yuen lands with six officers and a smile that doesn't reach her eyes, announcing New Lagos will be 'consolidated' within ninety days. Petra recognizes bureaucratic euphemism for erasure. POV: Petra. Beat: polite menace under ceremony.

chapters.title: What Idris Knew
chapters.summary: Idris admits he helped falsify the Halcyon Step manifest years ago to hide deserters — including his sister Amara Okafor, who may still be alive in the deep colony. POV: Idris. Beat: guilt surfacing, trust fractured and re-forged.

chapters.title: Dreams Without Grammar
chapters.summary: Petra's Vess-dreams sharpen into coherent images: a tower of light at the edge of dead space, a door closing. She realizes the Vess are transmitting their own death record toward the relay. POV: Petra. Beat: wonder curdling into urgency.

chapters.title: Ninety Days
chapters.summary: Yuen offers Petra evacuation priority in exchange for signing off that the Vess language is extinct — a legal formality enabling total demolition. Petra stalls. POV: Petra. Beat: temptation framed as kindness.

chapters.title: The Deep Colony
chapters.summary: Petra and Idris descend into the abandoned mining levels where the deserters lived, finding Amara's journals and evidence the Fleet knew the Vess were sentient when it voted to withdraw support. POV: Idris. Beat: grief and vindication.

chapters.title: Amara
chapters.summary: They find Amara Okafor alive, half-feral, tending a garden of engineered fungi and speaking fluent Vess-sign. She refuses to trust anyone wearing Fleet colors. POV: Amara (first appearance). Beat: feral hope, wary alliance.

chapters.title: The Truce Clock
chapters.summary: Amara explains the treaty: if no verified Vess transmission is logged before the truce expires, the Fleet may legally classify them vermin. The relay is the only verification point. POV: Amara. Beat: stakes crystallized into a deadline.

chapters.title: Yuen's Second Offer
chapters.summary: Yuen, suspicious of Petra's absences, promotes her to cultural attaché — a gilded leash. Petra accepts, buying access while hiding her research. POV: Petra. Beat: corruption begins with a small yes.

chapters.title: Archive Fire
chapters.summary: A fire destroys the colonial records hall; Petra salvages one drive containing the Halcyon Step's true flight logs. She suspects Yuen ordered it. POV: Petra. Beat: loss hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: The Old Pilot
chapters.summary: They recruit Sefu Bello, a disgraced pilot who flew the Halcyon Step's only unauthorized test hop and has nursed a grudge for fifteen years. POV: Sefu. Beat: bitter humor, reluctant crew assembling.

chapters.title: What Loyalty Costs
chapters.summary: Fleet security interrogates Idris about the manifest discrepancy. He gives up nothing but comes out knowing they're watching. POV: Idris. Beat: loyalty tested under pressure.

chapters.title: Signal in the Static
chapters.summary: Petra decodes the Vess dream-transmissions fully: they contain coordinates for the relay and a complete history of the colony — including the Fleet's crimes. POV: Petra. Beat: revelation; the language she dreams is testimony.

chapters.title: Departure Window
chapters.summary: With thirty days left, the crew preps the gutted freighter Long Answer for a run through dead space where no rescue can follow. POV: Sefu. Beat: point of no return approached with dark jokes.

chapters.title: The Bribe
chapters.summary: Yuen catches Petra copying archives and offers everything — safety, status, Idris's freedom — if she surrenders the drive. Petra lies to her face for the first time. POV: Petra. Beat: the theme made personal; lying as self-corruption.

chapters.title: Launch
chapters.summary: The Long Answer slips orbit during a debris storm, pursued briefly by a Fleet cutter that breaks off at the dead-space boundary. POV: Sefu. Beat: exhilaration shadowed by irrevocability.

chapters.title: Dead Space, Day One
chapters.summary: Silence, rationing, and the vast indifference of nothing. Amara teaches Petra Vess-sign; Petra teaches her why languages die. POV: Amara. Beat: intimacy born of isolation.

chapters.title: The Ghost Ship
chapters.summary: They dock with a derelict Fleet hospital ship to scavenge fuel and find evidence of the plague the Fleet denied ever reaching New Lagos. POV: Idris. Beat: horror confirming the archive.

chapters.title: Mutiny Weather
chapters.summary: Sefu's old crew debt catches up via automated bounty drone; a firefight costs them their water recycler and nearly their unity. POV: Sefu. Beat: external threat exposing internal fault lines.

chapters.title: Petra's Confession
chapters.summary: Petra admits she signed the extinction certification's preliminary draft years ago, believing the Vess gone. Amara walks out; Idris stays. POV: Petra. Beat: midpoint moral collapse — she is not innocent.

chapters.title: Alone With the Dream
chapters.summary: Petra dreams the Vess memory of first contact: they chose to teach humans language knowing it might destroy them, because silence would certainly have. POV: Petra. Beat: forgiveness sought from the dead.

chapters.title: Repair and Reckoning
chapters.summary: Amara returns, not forgiving but pragmatic: the mission matters more than Petra's soul. They rebuild the recycler together in silence. POV: Amara. Beat: cold peace, working trust.

chapters.title: Interception
chapters.summary: Yuen's cutter, running illegal dark, ambushes them at a navigation buoy. Sefu threads a debris field to escape; the ship is scarred. POV: Sefu. Beat: rising action — the enemy is desperate too.

chapters.title: Why Yuen Wants It Buried
chapters.summary: Captured Fleet data reveals Yuen's career was built on the New Lagos cover-up; exposure means treason charges for everyone who signed. POV: Yuen (first antagonist POV). Beat: antagonist humanized — fear, not evil.

chapters.title: The Relay at the Edge
chapters.summary: They reach the relay's outer shell: ancient, half-dead, humming with Vess architecture older than the colony itself. POV: Petra. Beat: awe — arrival at the mythic place from her dreams.

chapters.title: Inside the Tower of Light
chapters.summary: Amara opens the Vess door with sign-language; inside, the relay holds a living archive — every voice the colony ever lost. POV: Amara. Beat: cathedral wonder, grief transfigured.

chapters.title: The Verification Problem
chapters.summary: Broadcasting requires a bilingual key: a human voice speaking Vess truth, authenticated by both species' protocols. Only Petra qualifies — and authentication exposes her signature on the draft certification. POV: Petra. Beat: truth demands self-indictment.

chapters.title: Truce Expires
chapters.summary: The countdown hits zero; Fleet authorization for 'pest control' activates. Yuen's cutter enters weapons range of the relay. POV: Yuen. Beat: clock runs out; climax begins.

chapters.title: Standoff at the Door
chapters.summary: Yuen boards, offering Petra one last exit before the cutter fires. Idris steps between them; Sefu powers the relay's defensive lattice — Vess tech that shouldn't answer him, but does. POV: Idris. Beat: loyalty made physical.

chapters.title: The Broadcast
chapters.summary: Petra speaks the full record — the plague, the abandonment, the deserters, her own signature — in Vess and human tongues. The relay lights up across dead space, visible from every colony world. POV: Petra. Beat: climax; truth as an act of self-destruction and salvation.

chapters.title: What the Light Showed
chapters.summary: Fleet command, watching the broadcast go system-wide, orders Yuen to stand down rather than be seen firing on witnesses. Her cutter goes dark and retreats. POV: Yuen. Beat: power folding when exposed to light.

chapters.title: Aftermath Aboard
chapters.summary: In the quiet after, Amara finally speaks to Petra in human language — a small, enormous gesture. Sefu plots the long way home. POV: Sefu. Beat: exhale; wounds acknowledged, not healed.

chapters.title: The Inquiry
chapters.summary: Weeks later, a Fleet tribunal convenes at New Lagos. Petra testifies again, this time in daylight, refusing amnesty that would require silence about others. POV: Petra. Beat: accountability chosen over comfort.

chapters.title: Yuen's Choice
chapters.summary: Yuen, offered a scapegoat's bargain, instead confirms the record in full — corrupt to the end, but honest at last. POV: Yuen. Beat: antagonist's dignity in defeat.

chapters.title: New Lagos, Unforgotten
chapters.summary: Supply ships arrive; the colony won't thrive, but it won't be erased. Idris takes charge of rebuilding the archives properly this time. POV: Idris. Beat: modest, earned hope.

chapters.title: The Vess Answer
chapters.summary: Through the relay, a faint new Vess transmission arrives — not a death record but a question, addressed to whoever kept listening. Petra weeps in two languages. POV: Petra. Beat: grace note; the story opens outward.

chapters.title: Dreaming Again
chapters.summary: Petra sleeps and dreams in both human and Vess at once — not healed, but whole enough. She begins writing a grammar for what comes next. POV: Petra. Beat: resolution of the inner arc.

chapters.title: The Gravity of New Lagos
chapters.summary: One year on: Petra, Amara, Idris, and Sefu stand at the rebuilt relay as the first joint human-Vess teaching expedition departs. Some things pull you back forever; Petra chose which gravity to obey. POV: ensemble. Beat: belonging earned, truth survived, home redefined.
